given: a stock row whose inventory_code is a hyphen-delimited location-batch-serial code such as "A12-B7-S001"
then: batch_number is set to the second hyphen-delimited segment ("B7") and serial_number to the third ("S001"), taken from the code by delimiter and not by fixed width

independence.rationale: AC1 only asserts the columns exist and are addressable; a build could add empty columns yet never populate them. This AC is the separately-breakable backfill-parse outcome on a conforming code.
